label: Accessible absence coverage rules out being without a source of dependence
meaning: Conditional support for the existing dependence-to-real-impossibility premise. If x depends for its being on y and could exist without y, the realization premise supplies an accessible contrast world. Coverage selects it, so soundness implies x is absent there, contradicting the witness. The three assumptions are explicit. Accessibility stays distinct from intervention outcomes, and the argument leaves the shared dependence primitive and the strict-ground map untouched.
